title: Victoria Run 2026 Review: Racing Through Indonesia's Largest Sports Complex
seo_title: Victoria Run 2026 Review | GBK Senayan, Jakarta
meta_description: Victoria Run 2026 review: October 11 at GBK Senayan -- a race through Indonesia's largest sports complex, home to an 88,000-seat national stadium.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) Senayan, this race runs through the largest sports complex in Indonesia, built around a stadium named for the country's first president.
verdict: Victoria Run's real draw is its venue: Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex, the largest sports complex in Indonesia, spanning 279 hectares in Central Jakarta and named after Sukarno, the country's first president. The complex's Main Stadium seats over 88,000, and the grounds include an indoor arena, an aquatic stadium, and a secondary stadium -- genuinely purpose-built athletic infrastructure rather than a repurposed mall or civic plaza. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) keep the format standard, though registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: Racing Through Indonesia's Largest Sports Complex
paragraphs: Victoria Run starts at GBK Senayan, offering 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances. [1] Gelora Bung Karno, built over 279 hectares in Gelora, Central Jakarta, is the largest sports complex in Indonesia -- formerly known as the Asian Games Complex and later the Senayan Sports Complex until 2001. [2] That scale and purpose-built athletic design make it a genuinely fitting venue for a road race, distinct from the malls and civic plazas hosting most other events in this research batch.

sections.heading: Named for Indonesia's First President
paragraphs: The complex's centrepiece, the Gelora Bung Karno Main Stadium, is named after Sukarno and seats over 88,083 spectators, primarily used for football matches. [2] Beyond the main stadium, the complex includes Istora Gelora Bung Karno (an indoor arena seating 7,166), the Aquatic Stadium, and the Madya Stadium (9,170 seats) -- a genuinely comprehensive sports campus.

sections.heading: A Historically Significant Venue
paragraphs: GBK's history as the site of the 1962 Asian Games gives it national symbolic weight beyond its scale alone -- it's one of Jakarta's most recognisable landmarks, regularly hosting major sporting and cultural events. [2] Running through grounds this historically significant is a genuinely different experience from a typical mall-anchored community race.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] Given the venue's central Jakarta location and national profile, this is worth watching closely for the official sign-up announcement.
